newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: U.N. to help Sri Lanka rebuild war-ravaged north.
newsitem.headline: U.N. to help Sri Lanka rebuild war-ravaged north.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Boutros-Boutros Ghali has assured Sri Lanka of support for the Indian Ocean island's plans to rebuild its war-ravaged north, the foreign ministry said on Tuesday.

The pledge was given when Sri Lanka's Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar called on the U.N. chief in New York where he is attending the 51st session of the general assembly, a ministry statement said.
"The Secretary-General said that despite donor fatigue the U.N. will endeavour to assist Sri Lanka in this programme," it said.

The project to rebuild the north, which has been devastated by a 13-year minority Tamil separatist insurgency in which the government says more than 50,000 people have died, is likely to cost as much as a billion dollars, it said.
The government plans to launch a major rehabilitation programme once the war is over in the north, it said.
The U.N. could also encourage organisations like the World Bank to consider Sri Lanka's requests for aid favourably, the statement said.
